---
name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve
title: ""
labels: "bug"
assignees: ""
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Severity** (technical impact — set by the reporter, see `DOCS/TEST-STRATEGY.md`)

- [ ] S1 Critical — site down, data loss, security hole (e.g. CSRF bypass)
- [ ] S2 Major — a core journey is broken with no workaround (e.g. contact form cannot be sent)
- [ ] S3 Minor — feature works with a workaround, or an a11y/visual defect on one page
- [ ] S4 Trivial — cosmetic, typo, console noise

**Priority** (urgency to fix — set by the maintainer during triage)

- [ ] P1 Fix now — blocks release, hotfix
- [ ] P2 Next release
- [ ] P3 Backlog
- [ ] P4 Won't fix / nice to have

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1\. Go to '...'
2\. Click on '....'
3\. Scroll down to '....'
4\. See error

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Actual behavior**
What actually happened, including error messages from the browser console.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Desktop (please complete the following information):**

- OS: [e.g. iOS]
- Browser [e.g. chrome, safari]
- Version [e.g. 22]

**Smartphone (please complete the following information):**

- Device: [e.g. iPhone6]
- OS: [e.g. iOS8.1]
- Browser [e.g. stock browser, safari]
- Version [e.g. 22]

**Regression test**
Link the test that reproduces this bug (required before the fix is merged).

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
